findings.description: Deferred PostgreSQL effects on account updates or command receipt insertion could commit a positive DTO inconsistent with durable account flag, controls version or credential status.
findings.resolution: Final command postconditions run after deferred settlement and exact receipt validation; account postcondition compares complete DTO/state witness. All four trigger cases now pass.

findings.description: Suppressed audit insertion could leave accepted account consent and a command receipt without an audit event.
findings.resolution: Account postcondition reads exact generated audit event and compares identity, actor, action, state transition, reason, request and canonical details. SQLite and migrated PostgreSQL rejection/rollback probes pass.

findings.description: Non-object TikTok capability JSON caused status evaluation to throw before a token could be obtained to pause an unhealthy account.
findings.resolution: Typed context guard reports admission unavailable and allows explicit pause; all five malformed persisted shapes now pass.

findings.classification: Retracted reviewer-fixture defect; no product fix
findings.description: Initial numeric eligible=1 probe did not persist its proposed JSON because ORM equality treats True==1. Original raw captures retained but do not prove a product defect.
findings.resolution: Force dirty JSON write, commit, refresh and assert actual stored integer type. Existing strict admission rejects it. Native admission source unchanged.

postgresql_scope: Cached PostgreSQL 17, owned random schemas, actual domain/current migrations. Two distinct-key/same-key concurrency cases plus five deferred/audit fault cases. Disposable container used network none, no published ports, tmpfs database; client shared its namespace. Container removed after final executions.
other_coverage: Direct and mounted HTTP strict fields, bool versions, null/NaN/infinity, malformed hashes and extra properties
Mounted authorization 401/403 and malformed admin UUID, unknown accounts and missing schema
Credential/account metadata fences, stale/ABA conflicts, same-key payload conflicts, historical replay after disconnect
Parent access expiry separated from Page access expiry; Page/parent data expiry, revocation and unresolved refresh ownership remain rejected
Pause preserves unresolved publication ownership and all local global automation ceilings remain off
limits: Local controlled tests and code review only; no live database, provider, upload, publishing or worker activation
No claim of full backend suite, deployed behavior or current production readiness
Historical replay deliberately returns original receipt; it does not reapply consent or certify current connection state
mutations_by_reviewer: Evidence and independent test files only; no runtime source, branch, index, GitHub or production changes
Owned disposable local PostgreSQL fixture created and removed under coordinator authority
